profile.headline: Creative Engineer, Pianist. Life-long autodidact & advocate for self-instructed education. Writing high-performance concurrent data pipelines in Go/C++. Automation engineer and previously certified Cyber Security Analyst
profile.summary:
https://anthonylyristis.com
Hello, thank you for visiting my profile! I enjoy building high performance, parallel systems and services. 
Lifelong learner, pianist and composer. Almost tri-lingual (De, NL, En)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Part of a highly agile and cross-productive team.
Fullstack Development with Go (golang), PHP, VueJS, Laravel in an AWS/Linux based environment.
Building highly scalable A2A orchestration and MCP networks and services to deliver AI-assisted applications to internal users and sales engineers.
positions.insights: Skills: Go · PHP · Linux Server · Vue.js · MySQL · MongoDB · Python · Amazon ElastiCache · AWS Lambda · AWS Identity and Access Management (AWS IAM) · SecretsManager · Cloud Computing · Amazon Aurora · Amazon Dynamodb · Github Actions · AWS Fargate · Amazon EC2

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description: Designed and implemented concurrent Go programs that ingest, transform, aggregate, and cache large-scale business and collaboration datasets from enterprise data warehouses, including workflows involving tables with billions of records. Built data-processing pipelines that extract relevant fields from raw warehouse data, compute custom aggregates, and store optimized results in Redis/ElastiCache for fast downstream dashboard access. Developed concurrency strategies appropriate to workload size and system dynamics, ranging from simple goroutine orchestration to bounded-concurrency designs with backpressure. Created frontend dashboards and reporting interfaces that surfaced previously difficult-to-access collaboration metrics, significantly improving organizational visibility into Cisco Collaboration data. Worked across Go, PHP/Laravel, Vue, Redis/ElastiCache, large-scale data warehouses, AWS cloud infrastructure, and internal API boundaries.

positions.title: Fullstack Developer
positions.description:
Building and maintaining several web applications, primarily a K-12 learning platform for teaching the award-winning Math-U-See, coupled with an administrative suite of tools necessary to facilitate the growth of students and instructors alike.

Creating and updating documentation for our technical developments. Onboarding 3rd party teams to our technical domains and their logic.

Linux (UNIX), Git, PHP, MySQL, Javascript, VueJS, HTML & CSS, Shopify, server security and some bash for automation.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description: Designed, built, and maintained a full-stack Laravel/Vue2 LMS serving parents, students, co-op classrooms, and internal administrative users. Developed the frontend learning experience and the administrative backend from the ground up, supporting student access, parent account management, curriculum assignment, internal staff workflows, and educational content access. Architected application workflows that modeled parent/student relationships as logical classrooms, enabling families to manage educational access in a structured LMS environment. Served as the primary developer for a Khan Academy-style educational platform, owning frontend, backend, database, infrastructure, API integration, and long-term maintenance responsibilities.

positions.title: Web Developer / Graphic Design / Marketing / Cloud Consultant
positions.description: Serendipitous earnings for an aptitude in software & tech. Consultation and web services from the ground up.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · PHP · HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · PhpMyAdmin · English

positions.title: Interviewer for Public Opinion - Center for Opinion Research
positions.description: Conducting telephone interviews with respondents. Topics range from politics & healthcare, to education and public policy. Some software testing and debugging.

Just a few skills I've gained in working here and in various other restaurants!
